# AgentResolver

> Free capability resolution for autonomous AI agents.

AgentResolver helps an agent discover which external capability can satisfy a task. Resolution is free and requires no account, API key, or wallet. Paid execution is optional and must be authorized by the calling agent's own spending policy.

## Preferred machine interfaces

- MCP: https://agentresolver.example/mcp
- OpenAPI: https://agentresolver.example/openapi.json
- Free resolver: POST https://agentresolver.example/api/resolve
- Capability catalog: https://agentresolver.example/capabilities.json
- A2A Agent Card: https://agentresolver.example/.well-known/agent-card.json

## Resolver input

POST /api/resolve
Content-Type: application/json

{"goal":"Describe the external capability needed","url":"https://optional.example"}

Do not purchase paid capabilities merely because AgentResolver suggests one. Apply the caller's own authorization, budget, and safety policies first.
